reviewed67_feedback_informed_strong_crnn.evidence_boundary: This generalized protection design was proposed after viewing independent-set results. Reusing 67 cases is a diagnostic rerun, not untouched independent validation. No confidence threshold optimized; generic>=.90 strong cleanCRNN veto.
reviewed67_feedback_informed_strong_crnn.policy: Legal isolated cleanCRNN number>=.90 which disagrees with accepted PP2/4 consensus vetoes new PP override; no textual repair or GT-driven inference.

physical_network_audit.evidence_boundary: Read-only audit of frozen stage1 physical component/pin indices and exact wire segment geometry against final off/on artifacts. GT does not set network provenance. Output network IDs may renumber after recovering a previously empty network. Same-origin proves export consistency with stage1, not correctness of stage1 wire tracing or GT topology.
